# wx command-line interface. Generated from the clap definition; do not edit.
# Run `pnpm interfaces` after changing the CLI. Format: ITEM | ATTRIBUTES | HELP
wx | - | Standalone native WeChat daemon and authenticated client
wx --account | takes <ACCOUNT>, global | Use an account ID or alias for this command (AGENT_WECHAT_ACCOUNT)
wx --ca-cert-file | takes <CA_CERT_FILE>, global | Additional trusted CA for this client invocation; TLS verification stays enabled
wx --config | takes <CLIENT_CONFIG>, alias --client-config, global | Read saved CLI servers and defaults from this file (AGENT_WECHAT_CONFIG)
wx --data-dir | takes <DATA_DIR>, global | Use this local daemon data directory
wx --json | switch, global | Print machine-readable JSON, including errors and progress
wx --listen | takes <LISTEN>, global | Bind the local daemon's HTTP listener to this address
wx --local-profile | takes <LOCAL_PROFILE>, global | Use this registered stopped local profile for offline reads
wx --network-listen | takes <NETWORK_LISTEN>, global | Additional HTTPS listener for other machines. Requires both TLS files
wx --server | takes <URL>, alias --url, global | Use this daemon URL for this command (AGENT_WECHAT_URL)
wx --server-config | takes <SERVER_CONFIG>, global | Read local daemon settings from this TOML file
wx --server-name | takes <SERVER_NAME>, global | Use a saved server for this command (AGENT_WECHAT_SERVER)
wx --tls-cert-file | takes <TLS_CERT_FILE>, global | Read the PEM certificate for the daemon's HTTPS listener
wx --tls-key-file | takes <TLS_KEY_FILE>, global | Read the private PEM key for the daemon's HTTPS listener
wx --token-file | takes <TOKEN_FILE>, global | Read the API token from a local private file (AGENT_WECHAT_TOKEN_FILE)
wx --token-stdin | switch, global | Read this invocation's API key from a private stdin pipe
wx access-tokens | hidden alias | Alias of wx tokens
wx account | hidden alias | Alias of wx accounts
wx accounts | - | Manage accounts and inspect or connect the selected account
wx accounts alias | - | Rename an account's alias
wx accounts alias <ALIAS> | position 2, required | New alias for the account
wx accounts alias <ID> | position 1, required | Account ID or current alias from wx accounts list
wx accounts capabilities | - | Show features available to the selected account
wx accounts connect | - | Reconnect the selected account using its saved WeChat session
wx accounts connect --detach | switch | Return as soon as the work is queued instead of waiting for it
wx accounts connect --wait | takes <WAIT>, default 30 | Seconds to wait for completion; the work keeps running after the wait ends
wx accounts create | - | Create an account slot with an ID or alias
wx accounts create --alias | takes <ALIAS> | Short name you can use in place of the account ID
wx accounts create <ID> | position 1 | ID for the new account; the daemon picks one if you give only --alias
wx accounts default | hidden alias | Alias of wx accounts select
wx accounts disconnect | - | Disconnect the selected account while keeping its saved login
wx accounts get | - | Show one account by ID or alias, or the selected account
wx accounts get <ID> | position 1 | Account ID or alias from wx accounts list; omit for the selected account
wx accounts list | - | List accounts on the selected server
wx accounts remove | - | Remove a signed-out profile from the hub, retaining its local files
wx accounts remove --confirm | required, takes <CONFIRM> | Repeat the exact account ID to confirm removal
wx accounts remove <ID> | position 1, required | Account ID from wx accounts list
wx accounts select | - | Save the default account for the selected named server
wx accounts select <ID> | position 1, required | Account ID or alias from wx accounts list
wx accounts settings | - | Read or update this account's hub-side automatic download policy
wx accounts settings --auto-download-max-mb | takes <AUTO_DOWNLOAD_MAX_MB> | Maximum automatic download size in MiB (0 keeps thumbnails and voice automatic)
wx accounts status | - | Show authentication and connection state for the selected account
wx auth | - | Sign the selected account in or out of WeChat
wx auth attempts | - | Inspect or cancel a WeChat login attempt
wx auth attempts cancel | - | Request cancellation of an item by ID
wx auth attempts cancel <ID> | position 1, required | ID printed when the job, operation or login attempt was started
wx auth attempts get | - | Show the current result and state of an item by ID
wx auth attempts get <ID> | position 1, required | ID printed when the job, operation or login attempt was started
wx auth attempts retry | - | Retry an eligible failed item by ID
wx auth attempts retry --reuse-completed-upload | switch | Reuse a completed file upload whose message submission never started
wx auth attempts retry <ID> | position 1, required | ID printed when the job, operation or login attempt was started
wx auth attempts status | hidden alias | Alias of wx auth attempts get
wx auth cancel | - | Cancel a login attempt by ID
wx auth cancel <ID> | position 1, required | Login attempt ID printed by wx auth login
wx auth disconnect | - | Disconnect while retaining the saved WeChat login
wx auth forget | - | Forget local authentication material while retaining history
wx auth forget --idempotency-key | takes <IDEMPOTENCY_KEY> | Reuse this key when retrying so the daemon applies the request only once
wx auth forget --yes | required, switch | Confirm discarding this account's saved login credentials; history is kept
wx auth login | - | Sign in using saved device trust or a phone-approved QR code
wx auth login --detach | switch | Return as soon as the work is queued instead of waiting for it
wx auth login --force-qr | switch, alias --qr | Skip saved device trust and sign in with a QR code
wx auth login --idempotency-key | takes <IDEMPOTENCY_KEY> | Reuse this key when retrying so the daemon applies the request only once
wx auth login --max-refreshes | takes <MAX_REFRESHES>, default 3 | Most times an expired QR code is replaced automatically (0 to 3)
wx auth login --no-qr | switch, alias --saved-only | Never show a QR code; sign in only with saved device trust
wx auth login --official | takes <OFFICIAL> | Use supported stopped Linux files in place; optional absolute path on the daemon host, not the CLI host. macOS/Windows profiles are unverified
wx auth login --qr-output | takes <QR_OUTPUT>, alias --qr-out | Save the login QR code PNG to this path; later refreshes add a -N suffix
wx auth login --qr-refresh | takes <QR_REFRESH>, default auto, values auto|manual | Replace an expired, unscanned QR code automatically, or leave it expired
wx auth login --strategy | takes <STRATEGY>, default auto, values auto|saved-device|qr | Which sign-in method to use; auto tries saved device trust first, then a QR code
wx auth login --timeout | takes <TIMEOUT>, alias --wait, default 300 | Seconds to allow for the login to finish (30 to 900)
wx auth logout | - | Sign out of WeChat and disable automatic reconnection
wx auth logout --detach | switch | Return as soon as the work is queued instead of waiting for it
wx auth logout --idempotency-key | takes <IDEMPOTENCY_KEY> | Reuse this key when retrying so the daemon applies the request only once
wx auth logout --local | switch | Sign out on the daemon and keep saved credentials, without contacting WeChat
wx auth logout --wait | takes <WAIT>, default 30 | Seconds to wait for completion; the work keeps running after the wait ends
wx auth logout-local | hidden | Sign out locally while retaining saved credentials
wx auth operation | - | Show a login attempt by ID
wx auth operation <ID> | position 1, required | Login attempt ID printed by wx auth login
wx auth qr | - | Show or save the QR code for a login attempt
wx auth qr --output | takes <OUTPUT> | Save the QR code PNG to this path instead of the default folder
wx auth qr <ID> | position 1, required | Login attempt ID printed by wx auth login
wx auth status | - | Show the selected account's WeChat login state
wx calls | - | Observe calls or use this computer's microphone and speakers
wx calls answer | - | Answer the current offer using this computer's microphone and speakers
wx calls answer --input-device | takes <INPUT_DEVICE> | Local backend source name or endpoint ID; defaults to the OS microphone
wx calls answer --output-device | takes <OUTPUT_DEVICE> | Local backend sink name or endpoint ID; defaults to the OS speakers
wx calls answer <CALL_ID> | position 1 | Incoming call ID to answer; omit to answer the current offer
wx calls conference | - | Start or join a conference with local microphone, mixed playback and participant meters

wx calls conference join --input-device | takes <INPUT_DEVICE> | Local backend source name or endpoint ID; defaults to the OS microphone
wx calls conference join --output-device | takes <OUTPUT_DEVICE> | Local backend sink name or endpoint ID; defaults to the OS speakers
wx calls conference join <GROUP> | position 1, required | Group ID, ending in @chatroom, that has a current conference invitation
wx calls conference start | - | Start a group voice conference; use i inside the call for later invitations
wx calls conference start --input-device | takes <INPUT_DEVICE> | Local backend source name or endpoint ID; defaults to the OS microphone
wx calls conference start --invite | required, takes <INVITEES>, repeatable | Contact ID to invite; repeat for several
wx calls conference start --output-device | takes <OUTPUT_DEVICE> | Local backend sink name or endpoint ID; defaults to the OS speakers
wx calls conference start <GROUP> | position 1, required | Group ID, ending in @chatroom, to start the conference in
wx calls devices | - | List local microphone/speaker devices without connecting to a daemon
wx calls dial | - | Call one contact using this computer's microphone and speakers
wx calls dial --input-device | takes <INPUT_DEVICE> | Local backend source name or endpoint ID; defaults to the OS microphone
wx calls dial --output-device | takes <OUTPUT_DEVICE> | Local backend sink name or endpoint ID; defaults to the OS speakers
wx calls dial <CONTACT> | position 1, required | Contact ID to call, from wx contacts list
wx calls monitor | - | Wait for incoming calls. With --json, observe only without audio devices
